name: integration
wording: How a change joins the project's shared work: branching model, pull requests, who joins and when are the project's own conventions, which the workflow follows and never names. Under any convention a change joins only once every check passes and, where its review comes before it joins, once that review approves it; where the operator reviews it, once the operator signs it off. How a harness hands a dispatched agent's work back to its dispatcher is inside one task and is not integration.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
